## Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI - per-minute consumption
Input tokens (`ProcessedPromptTokens`) and output tokens (`GeneratedTokens`) kept separate, requests (`AzureOpenAIRequests`) and PTU utilization (`Provisioned-managed Utilization V2`).

> **Limits**: charts support ~10,000 points and 100 series; with PT1M use ranges <= 6 days (1 day recommended). The 25 deployments with the highest volume are shown. A metrics query supports up to 200 resources. **For per-minute P95/P99 and 30-90 day periods use `Export-FoundryTokenMetrics.ps1` + `foundry_token_stats.py`.**

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.label: OpenAI/AIServices accounts
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where kind in~ ('OpenAI','AIServices')
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true, group = subscriptionId

content.title: Account inventory
content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where id in~ ({Resources})
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project Account = id, kind, location, SubscriptionName, resourceGroup, sku = tostring(sku.name)
| order by SubscriptionName asc, Account asc

content.json: _Utilization V2 only returns data for Provisioned / Global/Data Zone Provisioned deployments. It is a percentage: never sum it across deployments._

## Per model / deployment detail
Totals for the selected range per deployment (all selected accounts). Token metrics only have the `ModelDeploymentName` dimension; `AzureOpenAIRequests` also has `ModelName`/`ModelVersion`. Below, pick an **account and deployment** to see tokens per minute (TPM), requests by `StatusCode` (429, other 4xx, 5xx) against its limit, latency (time to response / time to last token) and availability. Latency metrics are only emitted for minutes with traffic; empty charts on idle deployments are expected.

parameters.name: DetailResource
parameters.label: Account
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where id in~ ({Resources})
| project value = id, label = name, group = subscriptionId

## Quota by subscription and region
Quota is assigned per **subscription + region + deployment type + model** (or a shared PTU pool). The table shows the capacity assigned to deployments versus the limit (units; usually 1 unit = 1,000 TPM, check the deployment `rateLimits` for the exact factor). Actual per-minute consumption % against quota is computed by `foundry_token_stats.py` (*Quotas* sheet and `foundry-quota-utilization` CSV), because it requires summing all deployments of the quota minute by minute. Metrics count processed tokens; the rate limiter counts estimated tokens (prompt + max_tokens), so 429s are the direct saturation signal.

parameters.name: QuotaLocation
parameters.label: Region (quota)
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| distinct location
| order by location asc
